titre: Devoir de synthèse n°2 - Anglais (2ème année secondaire)

exercices.enonce:
TEXT
Child labour is a painful reality in many parts of the world. Millions of children, instead of going to school, are forced to work in fields, factories or workshops, often in dangerous conditions. These children lose their childhood, ruin their health and have no chance to build a better future. How can a tired child, working ten hours a day, dream, learn and grow like other children? Fighting child labour is everyone's responsibility. Governments must pass strict laws, families must understand the importance of education, and companies must refuse to exploit children. Every child has the right to a protected childhood and to go to school.

I. READING COMPREHENSION (6 marks)
1) What problem does the writer denounce?   (2 marks)
2) What are the consequences of child labour on children? Give two.   (2 marks)
3) What solutions does the writer propose?   (2 marks)

II. LANGUAGE (6 marks)
1) Put into the passive: "Companies exploit children."   (2 marks)
2) Complete with "must": Governments ______ pass strict laws.   (1,5 marks)
3) Give the opposite of "protected" = ______.   (1,5 marks)
4) "instead of going to school": what does this expression express (contrast / cause)?   (1 mark)

III. WRITING (8 marks)
"Every child has the right to education." Write a composition (about 12 lines) explaining the importance of education for children and how to protect this right. Use linkers and examples.
